analysis_md:
解答 由极坐标方程可得参数方程 $\left\{\begin{array}{l}x=\theta^2\cos\theta\\y=\theta^2\sin\theta\end{array}\right.$ 两边同时对 $\theta$ 求导可得

$$\frac{dx}{d\theta}=2\theta\cos\theta-\theta^2\sin\theta,\quad \frac{dy}{d\theta}=2\theta\sin\theta+\theta^2\cos\theta,$$

可得 $\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{dy/d\theta}{dx/d\theta}=\frac{2\theta\sin\theta+\theta^2\cos\theta}{2\theta\cos\theta-\theta^2\sin\theta}=\frac{2\tan\theta+\theta}{2-\theta\tan\theta}.$
